M2PriorMethod: Actual NORMAL/HARD centre-soft3each and two pressure patterns; six+six selected literal launch/movement/contact sequences, source PNG crops and direct-winner point UI. Not live physical play/listening, human strategies or automatic scoring.
M2PriorGap: Some central low AI contacts obscured by near gold athlete.
cameraContract: No camera position/FOV/court/screen shrink; compare same naturally reached held contact at identical state/camera, baseline twice pixel-exact before variants.
physicsContract: No physics/prediction/AI/command/pose/time changes in shipped logic. Diagnostic holds separate from ordinary play.
alternatives: localized actual-contact aperture using cloned opaque alpha-test materials
stagnationRule: Three no-improvement observations require changed approach; no weaker gate or rubric.
